opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to money deposited into a trading pool and describes a recruitment structure in which a member must fund an account and place people on both sides of the business. It states that a participant needs “at least $200 in your own Trading Pool account” and explains that an upline and joined members populate separate power and profit legs. Earnings are presented through recurring binary bonuses, including a bonus “every Saturday” based on the leg with less money invested, while the speaker says members can earn “good bonuses weekly if you build a team.” The presentation also describes putting in “roughly 10 times” the expected monthly amount and directs viewers to contact the sender for more information, reinforcing a money-funded, tiered recruitment opportunity.

citations.quote: at least $200 in your own Trading Pool account
one leg which is known as the power leg
roughly 10 times what you expect to get monthly
